title: Cleft + emphasis
recall: Cleft gap qanday tuziladi (What…, It was… who/that)? Fe'lni qanday ta'kidlaysiz (do/did)?
formula: What I need is… / What happened was… / All I want is… / The thing is…
It was John who called (boshqa odam emas); It's the price that worries me
do / does / did + V1 urg'u bilan: I DO like it; She DID call you

pairs.b: What I need is a holiday.
It was Ali who broke the window.

en: What I need is a holiday.
What I need is a rest.
What I need is a break.
It was Ali who broke the window.
It was Ali that broke the window.
What worries me is the price.
It's the price that worries me.

items.uz: Men bu filmni haqiqatan ham yoqtiraman.
en: I do like this film.
I really do like this film.
I do like this movie.
She did call you!
He did call you!
All I want is peace.
All I want is some peace.
The thing is, I don't have time.
The thing is that I don't have time.
It was yesterday that we met.
It was yesterday when we met.

items.uz: Bo'lgan voqea shunday: mashina buzilib qoldi.
en: What happened was that the car broke down.
What happened was the car broke down.

items.uz: Meni hayron qoldirgan narsa — uning xotirjamligi edi.
en: What surprised me was his calmness.
What surprised me was how calm he was.
What I don't like is lying.
What I hate is lies.
What I don't like is lies.
It was you who helped me.
It was you that helped me.
He did try.
She did try.
He really did try.

items.uz: Biz qilishimiz kerak bo'lgan narsa — kutish.
en: What we need to do is wait.
What we have to do is wait.

items.uz: Meni aynan uning gaplari xafa qildi.
en: It was what he said that upset me.
It was his words that upset me.

items.uz: Men uni qayerda uchratganimni eslay olmayman — aynan Samarqandda edi.
en: It was in Samarkand that I met him.
It was in Samarqand where I met him.

items.uz: Menga eng yoqqan narsa — uning hazili.
en: What I liked most was his sense of humour.
What I liked most was his humour.
What I liked best was his sense of humor.
All I want to do is relax.
All I want is to relax.
You're right, I did make a mistake.
You are right; I did make a mistake.
What causes the problem is a lack of time.
The reason for the problem is a lack of time.
What causes the problem is lack of time.

speak: Hayotingizda nima muhim? 5 ta 'What … is …' gap.
Bir voqea: It was … who/that … bilan aniqlang (3 ta).
Kimdir sizga ishonmayapti — do/did bilan 3 ta ta'kidli gap.
